application_review: The actual dependent product-group coset space modulo the product of the original subgroups is homeomorphic to the product of the original coset spaces. The map has the literal coordinate representative formula, is bijective and continuous in both directions, and transfers compactness. No subgroup is assumed normal.

Finite products of discrete original subgroups are proved discrete by the actual coordinate embedding. Arbitrary products with one fixed lower-central cutoff retain that cutoff and nilpotency-class bound.

The joint group is the dependent product of the actual native array groups, permitting different variable sets, Lie groups, models and finite determining families. Its specified lattice is the exact product of all-integer original pointwise lattices, with a literal all-component/all-integer membership theorem. Finite-index lattice discreteness, compact quotient and the unchanged common nilpotency cutoff are proved from the component results.

The actual joint model array, time orbit and constant step are constructed in that same dependent product group. The joint orbit is exactly a power of the single joint step times its initial state, and its actual product-lattice coset orbit is the corresponding original left group action. Every component integer coset evaluation is continuous and has the original g_i^(k_i+t_i*ell+sum z_j Delta_ij)*x_i formula.

Componentwise integer shifts form actual joint group automorphisms preserving the exact product lattice. They descend to continuous joint coset translations with additive composition, zero identity and opposite-shift homeomorphism inverses. Original component evaluations shift by z+v_i; model offsets shift by their exact affine sums and the orbit step is fixed. These formulas also hold for the whole joint time orbit.

Reviewed product cosets without normality: equivalence is proved by the original inverse-product membership relation. Its inverse continuity uses the product of actual open quotient projections; compactness is transported along this actual homeomorphism.

Reviewed finite versus infinite hypotheses: lattice discreteness explicitly requires finite component index. Compactness of product cosets and a uniform lower-central cutoff are valid without finite index; no finite-dimensional smooth model is claimed for arbitrary products.

Reviewed exact joint lattice: membership quantifies over every component and every integer input, not only the finite determining evaluation families. The component groups are the genuine exponential arrays, not the earlier generated polynomial-power groups.

Reviewed orbit and translations: the common time parameter acts by a single joint step under the original left action on the product-lattice coset space. Offsets and component inputs have literal formulas; all integer times and shifts are allowed.

Joint smooth finite-dimensional model assembly and quantitative reading calibration remain explicit obligations. All new named declarations are strictly elaborated and their transitive axioms checked; retained proof files and prior axiom sets are unchanged. No independent replay or full-target proof is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Integer input translations now preserve the actual graded coefficient Lie algebra, the full native exponential array group and its exact all-integer lattice; actual group and coset homeomorphisms and continuous coset evaluation with exact translation compatibility are proved. Array input translations are now proved smooth with smooth inverses in the existing original exponential charts. Original affine power-times-basepoint model arrays are proved to belong to the actual native array group; their exact evaluations, input translations and linear time orbit are proved both in the group and in its exact lattice coset space. Actual original and array discrete-lattice quotient manifolds are now constructed on the retained coset topologies; original quotient projections, all integer-input quotient evaluations and original quotient translations are smooth, with the latter having proved smooth inverses. The dependent product joint group, its exact product lattice, compact coset space, common nilpotency cutoff, original joint model orbit, component evaluations and input shifts are now constructed with exact formulas. A finite-dimensional smooth joint model and its integration with the quantitative native interface, quantitative smooth-observable estimates and downstream model-reading calibration remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the smooth joint-model interface and its connection to all prescribed quantitative readings, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
